recipe.visualDefinition: A sepia-toned, vintage-style photograph of an old, weathered storefront, framed by a distressed paper texture and held in place with two pieces of torn masking tape. The building features a prominent sign with 'LAWRENCE-GRO.' and smaller text 'FISHING-BAIT TACKLE & ICE'. An 'ICE' cooler is visible on the left, and a pickup truck is parked on the right. The overall aesthetic is rustic and nostalgic.
coreVisualRelationships: The central photograph is framed by a larger, textured paper background.
Two pieces of torn masking tape appear to adhere the photograph to the background.
The main title text is positioned centrally above the photograph.
The artist's name and logo are positioned centrally below the photograph.
coreInvariants: The sepia tone and distressed texture of the image and background must be maintained.
The torn masking tape elements must be present and appear to secure the central image.
The composition of the storefront, including the sign and surrounding elements, should be preserved.
The overall vintage and rustic aesthetic is crucial.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The storefront photograph occupies the majority of the central canvas, scaled to leave significant margins for the textured background and text elements. It is slightly rotated counter-clockwise.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large storefront sign 'LAWRENCE-GRO.' serves as the primary visual anchor within the photograph.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye is drawn from the top title, down to the central photograph, then across the storefront sign, and finally to the artist's name at the bottom. The tape elements add a subtle diagonal movement.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The textured paper background around the photograph acts as negative space, enhancing the focus on the central image and providing room for the top and bottom text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: The sepia tones (browns, creams, desaturated yellows) of the photograph and background establish a vintage, nostalgic mood.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Darker browns and blacks in shadows and text provide contrast against the lighter sepia and cream tones.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: There are no distinct accent colors; the palette is monochromatic sepia.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation and a wide range of values, from near-white creams to deep browns and blacks, create depth and a weathered appearance.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: The main title uses a sans-serif typeface with medium weight and regular width. The artist's name uses a similar sans-serif, while the logo-like element is a custom geometric design.

composition.relationshipToImage: positioned above and separate from the main photographic element

composition.position: bottom center, between artist name parts
composition.relationshipToImage: positioned below the main photographic element, integrated with text
positioned below and separate from the main photographic element

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Uses a single sans-serif typeface for all text, relying on size, tracking, and the custom logo for hierarchy and visual interest.

preserve: All-caps for main title and artist name.
The specific design of the geometric logo.

candidateDirections.reason: Geometric sans-serif with good readability and similar stroke characteristics.
Clean, neutral sans-serif that can achieve a similar feel with appropriate tracking.
Strong, geometric sans-serif with a similar all-caps presence.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sepia-toned, distressed paper texture as the base. Overlay a slightly rotated, sepia-toned photograph of an old storefront with a prominent sign, ensuring the building and surroundings match the reference's rustic feel. Add two torn masking tape elements, one in the top-left corner and one in the bottom-right, appearing to secure the photo to the background. Ensure the overall image has a vintage, worn aesthetic.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title text 'BANKS OF THE TRINITY' in all-caps, centered above the photograph, using a medium-weight, geometric sans-serif font with loose tracking, in a dark brown/black color. Add the artist's name 'CODY JOHNSON' in all-caps, centered below the photograph, using the same font but with normal tracking. Insert a custom geometric logo element between 'CODY' and 'JOHNSON', matching the reference's design and color.

verificationChecks: Is the overall image monochromatic sepia?
Are the torn tape elements present and correctly positioned?
Does the storefront photograph have a vintage, weathered appearance?
Is the main title text in all-caps and loosely tracked?
Is the artist's name in all-caps and correctly split by the logo?
Does the logo match the geometric design of the reference?

adjustableVariables: Intensity and pattern of paper distress/texture
Specific angle and placement of the torn tape elements
Scale and exact rotation of the central photograph
Tracking values for the main title and artist name

mustAchieve: A convincing vintage, sepia-toned photographic aesthetic.
The illusion of a physical photograph taped onto a textured background.
Clear legibility of all text elements.
A consistent rustic and nostalgic mood.
avoid: Sharp, clean edges on the photograph or tape.
Fonts that clash with the vintage aesthetic (e.g., highly decorative, futuristic).
Any elements that appear digitally pristine or artificial.

postGenerationChecks: Confirm that the sepia tone is consistent across all elements (photo, background, tape).
Verify that the tape elements appear organic and torn, not perfectly cut.
Check that the text is clearly readable against the background and photo.
Ensure the overall composition feels balanced and intentional.
Confirm that the custom logo element is accurately reproduced.
Assess if the vintage mood is strongly conveyed.
recipe.reuseFormula: Recreate a vintage sepia photograph of a rustic storefront, complete with an old sign. Place this photo on a distressed paper background, secured by torn masking tape. Overlay a geometric sans-serif title at the top and artist name with a custom logo at the bottom, maintaining the sepia color palette.
